verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API that lets scripts "access, create and manipulate" content with Bearer tokens, backed by an OpenAPI spec and an interactive reference, plus MCP integration. That covers creating notes from external workflows. It is a cloud API, though, not a URI scheme, deep link or local endpoint, and nothing shows it can open a note in the app; the Beta API is also due to be discontinued on September 1, 2026, with a successor portal. missing for 10: URI scheme / deep-link support, a local app endpoint, a way to open notes in the app from outside, hands-on corroboration.
